Selection for all Goa SSC Recruitment 2026 posts is through a Two-Tier Computer Based Test (CBT)
followed by a qualifying skill/ typing test.
Candidates must clear a qualifying typing skill test: 40 words per minute in English for Desktop Publishing Operator
and 30 words per minute in English for Lower Division Clerk/ Recovery Clerk
and Junior Assistant. The skill/ typing test is qualifying in nature only and does not count towards merit; final merit is based solely on CBT-II marks.

There is no negative marking in the Computer Based Test. Minimum passing marks in CBT: Unreserved (UR) - 45%; OBC - 40%; SC/ ST/ PwD - 35%. Passing the Konkani language test is mandatory for merit; candidates must score a minimum of 4 out of 10 marks in Konkani to be considered further. PwD candidates get compensatory time of 25 minutes in the 60-mark CBT and 35 minutes in the 80-mark CBT. CBT-I is common to all four posts and is used only for shortlisting/ screening. CBT-II for Desktop Publishing Operator (Sr. No. 1) is held separately; CBT-II for LDC/ Recovery Clerk
and Junior Assistant (Sr. No. 2-4) is common and held in one batch. Shortlisting for CBT-II: 10 times the number of posts per category for the Desktop Publishing Operator post
and 5 times the number of posts per category for the other three posts
based on CBT-I merit. After CBT-II

candidates who pass or are within 2 times the number of vacancies per category (whichever is lower) are called for the skill/ typing test. Final selection and merit are based only on CBT-II marks; the skill/ typing test is qualifying only. If two or more candidates score equal marks in the CBT
the candidate born earlier is given precedence. Department placement for LDC/ Recovery Clerk
and Junior Assistant posts is decided by the Commission based on proportionate representation; no request for change of allotted department will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Goa SSC Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Goa SSC Recruitment 2026 offers a total of 222 Group 'C' vacancies across four posts. The category-wise breakup as per the official notification is given below.

content_sections.heading: Goa SSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Essential qualifications for the Goa SSC Desktop Publishing Operator post are: Higher Secondary School Certificate in any stream from a recognized Board; training by the National Council for Vocational Training in Desktop Publishing Operator, or a Certificate of successful completion of Apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in the trade of Desktop Publishing Operator; 3 years of experience in the field of printing and publishing; practical knowledge of Layout Programme, Word Processing Programme, and Corel Draw; a typing speed of 40 words per minute; working knowledge of Devnagri Software; and knowledge of Konkani. Desirable qualifications are experience in operation and control of essential commodities, and knowledge of Marathi. These three posts share a common essential qualification: Higher Secondary School Certificate from a recognized board, or an AICTE-approved Diploma from a recognized State Board of Technical Education, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution; a minimum six-month Diploma/ Course Certificate in Computer from an Information Technology Knowledge Centre/ Computer Institute recognized by the Info Tech Corporation of Goa Limited (or an equivalent recognized body); a minimum typing speed of 30 words per minute in English; at least one year of working experience (as an apprentice, or in a Government/ semi-Government organization, factory, company, hospital, recognized educational institute, cooperative bank, or a private establishment employing 5 or more persons, among other listed categories); and knowledge of Konkani. Knowledge of Marathi is desirable. Candidates holding a Degree/ Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Information Technology, Electronics, Electronics and Telecommunication, or Electrical and Electronics from a recognized University/ State Board of Technical Education, along with a Trade/ Course Certificate in Computer Operator and Programming Assistant from a recognized Industrial Training Institute, are exempted from producing the separate Computer Diploma Course Certificate for the LDC/ Recovery Clerk, Data Entry Operator, and Junior Assistant posts.

content_sections.heading: Goa SSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for all four posts (Desktop Publishing Operator, LDC/ Recovery Clerk, Data Entry Operator, Junior Assistant) is not exceeding 45 years, relaxable for Government servants and others by up to five years as per applicable Government instructions. The cut-off date for determining eligibility for educational qualification, age limit, experience, and other documents is the last date of application, i.e. 02/ 10/ 2026. The Department of Personnel, Government of Goa, has exempted candidates belonging to the Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwD) category from the essential experience requirement, vide Order No. 1/ 8/ 2023-PER/ 2792 dated 08/ 09/ 2026. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.
